facts.fact: The Bank of Botswana licenses electronic payment services: under the amended regulations in force since 2 April 2026 no one may operate one without its licence, on pain of a P1 million fine or five years in prison.

BWA.note: Penalties and licensing are stated; no user conduct rule or complaints body is.
Money or value transfer services are mentioned only as a sector; no corridor is stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
No survey share of adults is given.

facts.fact: The amended regulations let licensed e-money issuers in Botswana pay interest to customers on electronic money balances, which the Bank says supports product innovation.

BWA.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
